title: atriplex latifolia subsp. triangularis
intro: Atriplex latifolia subsp. triangularis, commonly known as Three-angled Orache, is a subspecies of the Atriplex latifolia plant, belonging to the Amaranthaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis, coughs, and colds, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Three-angled Orache include soothing inflammation and reducing fever, thanks to its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
